title: helianthemum origanifolium subsp. serrae
intro: Helianthemum origanifolium subsp. serrae, commonly known as Serrate Rockrose, is a plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. This plant is known to offer various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in wound healing, reducing fever, and fighting against infections. The therapeutic actions of Serrate Rockrose include soothing and calming effects, making it useful for treating anxiety, insomnia, and stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
